records.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: canonical reference for a left-facing pixel-art demon god boss sprite, ONE complete full-body character on true transparent alpha.
Input image: the old six-armed demon god is ONLY a palette and game-art style reference. Completely redesign the body, head and pose as specified below.
Primary request: A colossal muscular TWO-ARMED humanoid demon god, floating in air, looking and facing LEFT with a clear 60-degree left-facing three-quarter side view. Only TWO arms, one near arm and one far arm, each attached normally to its respective shoulder. Enormous bare dark violet-gray stone-like deltoids, biceps, pectorals, abdomen; black-gold bracers, minimal black-gold waist and shin armor, short dark crimson split waistcloth. Exactly two legs dangling with gently bent knees and relaxed pointed feet, never planted on ground. No weapon.
Head: a smooth elongated faceted dark obsidian ovoid, tilted and projecting LEFT, completely blank inanimate monolithic surface. NO eyes, mouth, nose, ears, face holes, visor slit, face marks, horns, hair or crown. Use a simple angular silhouette and a few material facets only. Thick neck connected to massive shoulders.
Preserve the old black/purple, antique gold and deep crimson palette; small red-magenta chest core embedded in muscular chest. A thin dark-gold broken oblique halo floats BEHIND the upper body (not frontal or around head like a face), secondary silhouette, no extra limbs.
Pose: hovering idle, torso slightly reclined, near fist hangs at front-left of waist, far arm relaxed behind rib cage but its elbow and hand are both readable, legs hang together loosely and asymmetric, visible empty space below feet. Clear powerful muscular physique rather than full suit of armor.
Style/medium: refined fantasy JRPG pixel-art sprite, crisp deliberate pixel clusters, dark outlines, stepped edges, restricted palette. No smooth airbrush, photorealism, 3D, soft gradients or background glow.
Composition: square reference canvas, local coordinates 0..1024: torso/root around (540,515), blank head around (435,255), chest core around (490,410), near shoulder (475,365), far shoulder (605,355), near fist (355,570), far fist (650,555), knees around (490,720),(590,710), feet around (455,825),(590,815). Entire silhouette including halo inside x=160..850 y=110..865. Leave transparent margins and transparent area below feet. No ground, cast shadow, scenery, VFX, particle cloud, text, labels, grid, checkerboard or watermark.

Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: canonical transparent pixel-art demon god sprite reference.
Input image: edit target, the newly redesigned two-armed hovering demon god.
Primary request: Make ONLY the HEAD more magnificent and ornate for the final major boss. Keep the inanimate faceted monolithic obsidian head pointing LEFT, with absolutely NO eyes, mouth, nose, ears, visor slit, sockets, or any suggestion of a face. Keep the large central FRONT surface completely blank obsidian. Add rich antique-gold sculpted border following the OUTER silhouette of the head, small gold architectural relief/inlays along the crown/top and rear edges, and a handsome upward/backward sweeping crown crest made of three angular black-and-gold prongs at the TOP/REAR of the head, distinct from the halo. Elegant ritual regalia, large-boss quality, legible at small sprite sizes. These are decorative crown/frame shapes, not new horns or a face. Avoid any pair of jewel dots or bilateral motifs that could be read as eyes. Do not add any mouth-like seam on the blank front plane. Keep the original dark faceted head volume within the new ornamental frame.
Constraints: CHANGE ONLY head decoration. Keep EXACTLY TWO arms, muscular torso, pose, proportions, colors, red chest core, armor, crimson cloth, dangling two legs, halo, and leftward orientation exactly as in the input. Same crisp JRPG pixel-art clusters, stepped edge, dark outline, no smooth airbrush or 3D rendering. Keep full character and full crest inside image with clear transparent margins. True transparent alpha background, no ground, shadow, scenery, glow cloud, text, checkerboard or watermark.

note: Ornate reference is canonical. Upper crown has very little source padding but no opaque pixels on source edge; exported review adds transparent padding.
